ei.title: 7번: Why New Cars Worsen Car Sickness
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: About 25 to 30% of people suffer from car sickness. Their symptoms include nausea, sweating, headaches, and vomiting. Unfortunately, some technological advances make car sickness even worse. Electric cars, for example, are smoother and quieter than traditional cars. This has the downside of preventing passengers from getting used to the movement of the vehicle. With traditional cars, we associate acceleration with the sound of the engine getting louder. Electric cars, however, deprive us of this reference point. Another problem is the number of screens inside electric cars. They discourage passengers from looking outside. This makes it harder for them to correctly perceive their position in space, which worsens the symptoms of car sickness. In the future, fully automated vehicles will probably make things even worse. This is because the act of driving is one of the best ways to prevent car sickness.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

✅ ③ to get: 'preventing passengers from to get used to the movement' — prevent A from -ing 구문이므로 to get은 오류. getting이 맞음

questions.passage: About 25 to 30% of people suffer ①<u>from</u> car sickness. Their symptoms include nausea, sweating, headaches, and vomiting. Unfortunately, some technological advances make car sickness even worse. Electric cars, for example, are smoother and quieter than traditional cars. This has the downside of preventing passengers from getting used to the movement of the vehicle. With traditional cars, we associate acceleration with the sound of the engine getting louder. Electric cars, ②<u>however</u>, deprive us of this reference point. Another problem is the number of screens ③<u>insides</u> electric cars. They discourage passengers from looking outside. This makes it harder for them to correctly perceive their position in space, which worsens the symptoms of car sickness. In the future, fully automated vehicles will ④<u>probably</u> make things even worse. This is because the act of driving is one of the best ways to prevent car sickness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① from=~로부터(전치사 정상), ② however=그러나(접속부사 정상), ③ inside→insides 오류(전치사/부사로 쓰이는 inside에 복수 -s 불필요), ④ probably=아마(부사 정상)
det.analysis:
❌ ① from: 'suffer from car sickness' — 전치사 from 정상
❌ ② however: 'Electric cars, however, deprive us' — 접속부사 정상
✅ ③ insides: 'the number of screens insides electric cars' — inside는 전치사로 '~안에'의 의미. insides는 명사(내부)로 문법 기능이 다름. 전치사 자리에 명사 복수형 insides는 오류
❌ ④ probably: 'will probably make things' — 부사 정상
det.tip: inside(전치사) = ~의 안에. insides(명사) = 내부/내장. 전치사 자리에 명사 복수형은 불가

det.korean: 전기차가 빼앗는 것 = reference point(기준점)
det.analysis: 본문: 'Electric cars, however, deprive us of this reference point' — 전기차가 기준점을 빼앗음
det.tip: deprive us of = 우리에게서 빼앗다. reference point = 기준점(가속과 엔진 소리의 연관)

questions.stem: 위 글에서 완전 자동화 차량이 멀미를 더 악화시킬 이유가 되는 행위를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (영어로, 4단어)

det.korean: 멀미 예방의 최선 방법 = 운전 행위(the act of driving)
det.analysis: 본문: 'the act of driving is one of the best ways to prevent car sickness' — 운전 행위가 멀미 예방의 최선이므로, 자율주행으로 운전이 사라지면 멀미 악화
det.tip: the act of driving = 운전이라는 행위. 자율주행 → 운전 불필요 → 멀미 예방 불가

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: 기술 발전(전기차, 자동화)이 멀미를 악화시키는 이유와 메커니즘
det.analysis:
❌ ① 성능 비교: 비교가 목적이 아닌 멀미 악화 설명을 위한 수단
❌ ② 치료법: 치료법 언급 없음
❌ ③ 안전성: 안전 문제가 아닌 멀미 문제
✅ ④ 기술 발전이 멀미를 악화시키는 이유: 전기차(부드럽고 조용, 화면)와 자율주행(운전 행위 제거)이 멀미를 악화
det.tip: 글 전체 흐름: 기술 발전(전기차/자동화) → 감각 기준 제거 → 멀미 악화
